Name: Fence Repair
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
If you can craft them, why can't you repair them?


[size=5][b]Repair[/b][/size]

This mod lets you repair fences instead of having to replace them with new fences.

By default, repairing requires the same materials you would use to craft a fence - the materials can be in your hand, your inventory, or even a chest in the same location as the fence.

If you have the materials in your hand, the tool use key (Left Button on a mouse) will use them to repair the fence. Otherwise, the interact key (Right Button on a mouse) will repair the fence if the materials are found elsewherer.

You can disable material requirements and disable taking from chests or inventory in the config.


[b][size=5]Health Display[/size][/b]

Holding down a hotkey (default [b]Left Control[/b])  by default toggles a health bar and the remaining health above each fence segment. The color of the health bar varies based on the remaining health of the fence segment.

You can disable the remaining health number, change the text and health bar colors, and change the hold-to-show behaviour to toggle in the config.



[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url], you can also change the colors in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
